class.name: WebBoxShadow
class.description: [WebBoxShadow] describes one shadow of a CSS [code]box-shadow[/code] list, used by [StyleBoxCSS]. It mirrors the CSS syntax [code]<offset-x> <offset-y> <blur-radius> <spread-radius> <color> [inset][/code]. Multiple shadows are stacked in document order, first-on-top.

members.member: Gaussian blur radius in pixels — the third length of a CSS [code]box-shadow[/code]. A value of [code]0[/code] produces a sharp shadow. Cannot be negative.
Shadow color, alpha included. The color component of a CSS [code]box-shadow[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the shadow is drawn inside the border box instead of behind it. The CSS [code]inset[/code] keyword.
Horizontal and vertical shadow offset in pixels — the first two lengths of a CSS [code]box-shadow[/code].
Amount the shadow shape grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) before being blurred — the fourth length of a CSS [code]box-shadow[/code].
